title: Department
description: Organizational unit within a company representing a functional division such as Sales, Engineering, Marketing, or HR. Contains department structure, staffing, budget allocation, and management information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the department record

name.description: Official name of the department (e.g., Engineering, Sales, Human Resources)

code.description: Short alphanumeric code used internally to identify the department

manager_id.description: Employee ID of the department manager or head

employee_count.description: Total number of employees currently assigned to this department

budget.description: Annual budget allocation for the department in the company's primary currency

location.description: City or office location where the department is primarily based

description.description: Detailed description of the department's responsibilities, functions, and objectives

established.description: Date when the department was created or established within the organization
